The Clip Blender  CHOP  is a an engine for blending, sequencing and scripting animation clips. It loads animation channel data that is formatted using Clip CHOPs. It reads clip  CHOP  paths from a specified  DAT  list which can be dynamically scripted. The Clip Blender plays clips from the list  DAT ; each time it reads a clip, it pop's the item off the list, and when the next clip plays through it will continue playing and popping clips off the list until it is empty. Once the list is empty the last animation in the sequence is looped.
Animation clips will typically come from an FBX or USD asset but can also be read using the Houdini bclip format or raw chan format. Animation clips found in FBX assets must be extracted from the asset hierarchy and then loaded speerately into a  Clip CHOP . All  Clip CHOP 's loaded into the same clipblender must have the same number of channels, all channel names must match and the all clips must be the same sample rate.  If any of these 3 important requirements are not met, there will likely be animation glitches.
Use the  Info CHOP  and  Info DAT  to extract information about its current state. See also the  Clip CHOP  and  Clip DAT .

parameters.label: Default Clip  CHOP
parameters.name: default
parameters.description: Operator path to a valid  Clip CHOP .

parameters.label: DAT  List
parameters.name: datlist
parameters.description: Operator path to a valid  Table DAT .

parameters.label: Target
parameters.name: target
parameters.description: ⊞  - This parameter works in conjunction with the root transform channels as defined on the Channels page of the clpblender  CHOP  as well as the  Clip CHOP  parameter called Position Type. When Position Type is set to "Blend To Target" it will blend the root transform channels for the current clip to the new position defined in this parameter.

parameters.label: Play Speed
parameters.name: playspeed
parameters.description: Provides a scale value to slow down or speed up the playback of the animation sequence.

parameters.label: Step Forward
parameters.name: stepforward
parameters.description: Unknown

parameters.label: Step Backward
parameters.name: stepbackward
parameters.description: Unknown

parameters.label: A End  Script
parameters.name: aend
parameters.description: Broken

parameters.label: Delay Samples
parameters.name: delay
parameters.description: Delays the output of animation data by the specified number of samples.

parameters.label: Reset
parameters.name: reset
parameters.description: When On, resets the clipblender and holds it ready to play the clip defined by the Default Clip  CHOP  parameter.

parameters.label: Reset  Pulse
parameters.name: resetpulse
parameters.description: Instantly reset the cliblender and start playing the clip defined by the Default Clip  CHOP  parameter.

parameters.label: Output Time Remaining
parameters.name: timeremaining
parameters.description: A channel of the name defined in this parameter will return the time remaining in the current clip.

parameters.label: Time  Channel
parameters.name: timechannel
parameters.description: A channel of the name defined in this parameter will return the time elapsed in the current clip.

parameters.label: X  Root  Trans
parameters.name: xtrans

parameters.label: Z  Root  Trans

parameters.label: X  Root  Rot

parameters.description: The rotate X channel of the animation hierarchy that defines the  Clipblender Motion Root .

parameters.label: Y  Root  Rot
parameters.name: yrot
parameters.description: The rotate Y channel of the animation hierarchy that defines the  Clipblender Motion Root .

parameters.label: Z  Root  Rot
parameters.name: zrot
parameters.description: The rotate Z channel of the animation hierarchy that defines the  Clipblender Motion Root .

parameters.label: Queue Enable
parameters.name: qenable
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the queue enable channel that may be added to all animation clips that will be loaded into this clipblender. A "Queue Enable" channel may be added to the animation clip to define when this clip is safe and unsafe for blending into other clips. If the animation is not safe for blending, the channel would be set to 1, which means the clipblender should "Queue" the next clip in the sequence instead of playing it.  When the channel is 0, the any animation request will be executed immediately.

parameters.label: Queue Trigger
parameters.name: qtrigger
parameters.description: Unknown

parameters.label: Pre-Rotate Adds
parameters.name: prerotate

parameters.label: Time Slice
parameters.name: timeslice
parameters.description: Turning this on forces the channels to be " Time Sliced ".  A  Time Slice  is the time between the last cook frame and the current cook frame.

parameters.label: Scope
parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: To determine which channels get affected, some CHOPs use a  Scope  string on the Common page.

parameters.label: Sample Rate  Match
parameters.name: srselect
parameters.description: ⊞  - Handle cases where multiple input CHOPs' sample rates are different. When Resampling occurs, the curves are interpolated according to the Interpolation Method Option, or "Linear" if the Interpolate Options are not available.

parameters.label: Resample At Maximum Rate

parameters.label: Resample At Minimum Rate

parameters.description: Resample to the lowest sample rate.

parameters.label: Error If Rates Differ

parameters.description: line text or tables. Multi-line text is often a python  Script  or  GLSL  Shader, but can be any multi-line text.  Tables  are rows and columns of cells, each containing a text string.

parameters.label: A set of commands located in a Text DAT that are triggered to run under certain conditions. There are two scripting languages in TouchDesigner:  Python  and the original  Tscript . Scripts and single
parameters.description: line commands can also be run in the  Textport .

parameters.label: To "pulse" a parameter is to send it a signal from (1) an  exported  CHOP channel or (2) a python command or (3) a mouse click that causes a new action to occur immediately. A pulse via python is via the  .pulse()  function on a pulse
parameters.description: type parameter, such as Reset parameter in a  Speed CHOP . A pulse from a CHOP is typically a 0 to 1 to 0 signal in an exported channel.

parameters.label: TouchDesigner is a hierarchy of components. "root" is the top
parameters.description: most network in the hierarchy. The  Network Path  or Path for root is simply  / . A typical path is  /project1/moviein1 .

parameters.label: samples
parameters.description: per-second of a  CHOP . Each CHOP in your network has a sample rate. In contrast, the overall timeline has a  Frame Rate , which is the number of frames to  cook  and display per second, generally your monitor display frequency, default 60.
